title: SIEGE INCOMING NAMES NO COUNT
why: His order of 2026-10-12: Siege Incoming, do not tell how many machines are inbound. Calling for extraction showed SIEGE INCOMING with About N machines inbound under it. The headline stays and the count is gone, so he no longer knows how many are coming. The siege itself is unchanged: it is still sized by what you carry and the siege dial, and the machines come in at the same rate.
now: SIEGE INCOMING no longer says how many machines are coming.
